Published 12 November 2026
Gemini 4 Hydrogen
Model Cards are intended to provide essential information on Gemini models, including known limitations, mitigation approaches, and safety performance.
Description
Gemini 4 Hydrogen brings cutting-edge intelligence to everyone - with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows. While our frontier models, Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon, are built for deep, long-horizon reasoning on your hardest problems, Hydrogen is built for rapid execution across diverse agentic workflows.
Inputs
Text strings (e.g., a question, a prompt, document(s) to be summarized), images, audio, and video files, with a combined input-output token context window of up to 1M.
Distribution
Gemini 4 Hydrogen is distributed in the following channels; respective documentation shared in line:
Gemini app
Gemini API
Google Sheets
Google AI Studio
Gemini for business
Google Antigravity
Google Search
Our models are available to downstream providers via an application program interface (API) and subject to relevant terms of use. There is no required hardware or software to use the model.
Known Limitations
Gemini 4 Hydrogen may exhibit some general limitations such as hallucinations. The knowledge cutoff for Gemini 4 Hydrogen is March 2026, though in some domains the model's knowledge may be less up to date.
